ocean.colour_meaning: Sea-surface temperature: blue cooler, red warmer. Rendering intensity does not measure current speed.
ocean.modification: Full saved ECCO2 animation. All video frames retained without re-encoding, resizing, trimming or retiming. Original audio omitted. MP4 metadata moved to the front for playback.

aerosols.credits: NASA GMAO / Scientific Visualization Studio; Joseph V. Ardizzone, Helen-Nicole Kostis; scientific consulting Lesley Ott. Technical support Laurence Schuler, Ian Jones, Ella Kaplan.
aerosols.rights: NASA visualization; Wikimedia mirror identifies it as public domain (PD-NASA).
aerosols.modification: Wikimedia 1920 × 960 VP9 derivative used unchanged, with no further resizing or re-encoding. Video playback muted; no original audio used.
aerosols.colour_meaning: Blue/cyan sea salt; pink/magenta dust; orange/red smoke; green sulfate. Pixel brightness is not a retrieved concentration.

audio: Synthesized from selected image/video region colors; live video sampled up to four times per second. No AI model or training.
globe: UV sphere in GLB 2.0 with real NASA still texture. App supplies video frames separately.

sound_lab.atmosphere: Independent NASA MERRA-2 profile from 1 January 2025; model delay divided by 1000, artistic amplitude 0.25.
